ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Form and Analysis: Classical Era." This course will examine music of the 18th century and early 19th century with an emphasis on the use of common schemata and the rules and patterns of the partimento tradition of the Neapolitan conservatories as points of departure for composition. Students will reinforce their knowledge of the rules and schemata by studying simplified two-voice keyboard drills based on 18th-century partimenti.
